feeding_claim.verbatim: Our Bison happily roam around our ranch in the Colorado Rocky Mountains, near the Continental Divide, munching on the legendary North Park hay – they don’t finish on grain and they don't receive hormones or antibiotics.

pickup_locations: Lafayette, CO (meet at Walgreens, 309 N US Highway 287, by arrangement)
Double J Meat Packing, 726 W. Main, Pierce, CO (half and whole bison)

availability.note: Sold out of everything except liver until the fall harvest; half and whole bison reservations open in January for the Fall 2026 harvest.
